name: 启用使用和合同管理 (UPA) (6EF)
name_en: Enable for Use and Contract Management (UPA) (6EF)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item is only relevant for the Integration with SAP Cloud for Real Estate.

After you group Real Estate Objects (Buildings, Floors, Spaces, Land, Land Areas) in the Group Real Objects for Use SAP Fiori app, you can maintain these groups within the Manage Usage Enablement Groups Fiori app.

Usage Enablement Groups are assigned to a company, where they can collect operating costs on assigned cost objects (leading or additional assigned cost object) and be assigned to a real estate lease-in contract.

You can use the Contract Management SAP Fiori app to create lease-in contracts. Here you can easily create new contracts, execute periodic postings, and execute valuation postings for existing contracts.

You can change the supplier of an existing contract, as well as run reports of your existing contracts as part of your daily business.

You can create reminder rules for every contract, for example, to check the contract conditions, the contract term, or the renewal options, helping you to save time and effort and free up capacity for more strategic tasks.

Key Process Flow

  • Search for target building or land
  • Create enabled-for-use group with attributes (enable use type, controlling object type, usage type, validity dates and cost object ID)
  • Check enabled-for-use group

Business Benefits

  • Use a single repository for all real estate assets in the entire portfolio independent of back-end system
  • Collect costs by real estate location, supporting financial reporting and location analysis
  • See what fixed assets are used to support each enabled object
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目仅与与 SAP Cloud for Real Estate 集成相关。

在分组要使用的实际对象 SAP Fiori 应用中对不动产对象（建筑物、楼层、空间、土地、土地范围）进行分组后，您可以在管理使用支持小组 Fiori 应用中维护这些组。

使用启用组分配到公司，可在其中收集已分配成本对象（主要或附加已分配成本对象）的运营成本，并分配到不动产租入合同。

您可以使用合同管理 SAP Fiori 应用创建租入合同。在此，您可以轻松创建新合同、执行定期过账并执行现有合同的评估过账。

您可以更改现有合同的供应商，并在日常业务中运行现有合同的报告。

您可以为每个合同创建提醒规则，例如，检查合同条件、合同条款或续订选项，帮助您节省时间和工作量，并释放更多战略任务的能力。

关键流程流

  • 搜索目标建筑物或土地
  • 创建具有属性的启用使用组（启用使用类型、成本控制对象类型、使用类型、有效日期和成本对象标识）
  • 检查启用使用组

业务优势

  • 独立于后端系统，为整个投资组合中的所有不动产资产使用单一资源库
  • 按不动产位置收集成本，支持财务报告和位置分析
  • 查看用于支持每个已启用对象的固定资产。
